prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1362; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient is a adult who presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped by another vehicle while the other driver was changing lanes. The patient reported immediate pain, swelling, and reduced weight-bearing tolerance in the right knee. Initial evaluation included a physical examination and imaging, which showed a soft tissue injury to the medial knee with no evidence of fracture. Clinical findings were consistent with a medial collateral ligament sprain, graded as moderate.

Treatment consisted of 21 outpatient visits over the course of care. Interventions included activity modification, a structured physical therapy program focused on range of motion, quadriceps strengthening, and gait retraining, along with manual therapy and cryotherapy. The patient was progressively advanced through strengthening milestones as pain and swelling decreased.

At the most recent visit, the patient demonstrated near-full range of motion, stable ligamentous testing, and improved functional tolerance for daily activities and work duties. Residual mild stiffness with prolonged kneeling remains. The patient has been discharged to a home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
